mapper.sql: employees.*, employees.id AS employeeId, IFNULL(salary_second_work_shift, 0) AS secondWorkShiftSalary, code AS empId, positions.name AS positionName, positions.ordering AS positionOrdering, allowance AS allowance, paid_by AS paidType, is_deposit AS deposit, num_month AS numOfMonth, CASE WHEN (SELECT pay_slip_file_name FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND pay_date = #{payDate} LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isTelegram, is_donated AS donate, amount_deposit AS cashAmount, is_provident_fund AS proFund, start_working_date AS dateOfWork, remark AS remark, (SELECT total_amount FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND pay_date = #{payDate} LIMIT 1) AS totalAmount, (SELECT increase_salary FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND pay_date = #{payDate} LIMIT 1) AS increaseSalary, (SELECT note FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = employees.id AND pay_date = #{payDate} LIMIT 1) AS note
FROM employees LEFT JOIN positions ON positions.id = employees.position_id
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY employees.code ASC

SELECT * FROM departments WHERE is_active = 1
AND departments.id = #{filter.departmentId} AND id IN (SELECT department_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1)
ORDER BY group_id ASC
SELECT * FROM payroll_item_types WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM payroll_items WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_items.payroll_item_type_id = #{payrollTypeId} ORDER BY ordering ASC
SELECT payroll_item_id AS payrollItemId, amount AS amount, status AS payrollStatus FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_id = #{payrollId}

SELECT IFNULL(day_rate, 0) AS dayRate, IFNULL(night_rate, 0) AS nightRate, IFNULL(weekend_rate, 0) AS weekendRate, IFNULL(public_holiday_rate, 0) AS publicHolidayRate FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{employeeId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM public_holidays WHERE is_active = 1 AND DATE(#{date}) BETWEEN DATE(public_holidays.date_from) AND DATE(IFNULL(public_holidays.date_to, public_holidays.date_from))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM payroll_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND payroll_item_id = 5 AND total_of_months < 2 AND payroll_id IN (SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeesId} AND DATE(payrolls.pay_date) >= #{employeeStatusDate})
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM deposit_request_details WHERE is_active = 1 AND status = 2 AND employee_id = #{employeesId}

SELECT over_time_requests.id AS id, over_time_requests.date_time_from AS dateTimeFrom, over_time_requests.date_time_to AS dateTimeTo, DATE(over_time_requests.date_time_from) AS date, TIME(over_time_requests.date_time_from) AS timeFrom, TIME(over_time_requests.date_time_to) AS timeTo, over_time_requests.duration AS duration, NULL AS minute, NULL AS attendanceType, NULL AS attendanceStatus, 'OT_REQUEST' AS recordType, employees.employee_status_id AS employeeStatusId, NULL AS shiftDay FROM over_time_requests LEFT JOIN employees ON employees.id = over_time_requests.employee_id WHERE over_time_requests.is_active = 1 AND over_time_requests.employee_id = #{filter.employeeId} AND over_time_requests.status = 2 AND MONTH(over_time_requests.date_time_from) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND YEAR(over_time_requests.date_time_from) = YEAR(#{filter.date});

SELECT ea.id AS id, DATE(ea.datetime_scan) AS date, TIME(ea.datetime_scan) AS timeScan, ea.beginning_check_in AS timeIn, ea.beginning_check_out AS timeOut, ea.type AS type, ea.status AS status, ea.minute AS minute, IFNULL(ea.total_working_minute, 0) AS totalWorkingMinute, (SELECT CASE WHEN ws.work_shift_type_id = 2 THEN 24 ELSE HOUR(ws.duration) END FROM work_shifts ws WHERE ws.id = ea.work_shift_id LIMIT 1) AS shiftHour, ea.work_shift_id AS workShiftId, IFNULL((SELECT total_day_per_month FROM employee_table_shifts WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{filter.employeeId} AND work_shift_id = ea.work_shift_id LIMIT 1), 0) AS shiftDay FROM employee_attendances ea WHERE ea.is_active = 1 AND ea.employee_id = #{filter.employeeId} AND ea.status IN(2,3) AND MONTH(ea.datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND YEAR(ea.datetime_scan) = YEAR(#{filter.date})

SELECT ea.id AS id, (SELECT ea2.datetime_scan FROM employee_attendances ea2 WHERE ea2.employee_id = ea.employee_id AND ea2.type = 1 AND ea2.datetime_scan < ea.datetime_scan ORDER BY ea2.datetime_scan DESC LIMIT 1) AS dateTimeFrom, ea.datetime_scan AS dateTimeTo, DATE(ea.datetime_scan) AS date, TIME((SELECT ea2.datetime_scan FROM employee_attendances ea2 WHERE ea2.employee_id = ea.employee_id AND ea2.type = 1 AND ea2.datetime_scan < ea.datetime_scan ORDER BY ea2.datetime_scan DESC LIMIT 1)) AS timeFrom, TIME(ea.datetime_scan) AS timeTo, CASE WHEN employees.employee_status_id = 1 THEN IFNULL(ea.minute, 0) ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, (SELECT ea2.datetime_scan FROM employee_attendances ea2 WHERE ea2.employee_id = ea.employee_id AND ea2.type = 1 AND ea2.datetime_scan < ea.datetime_scan ORDER BY ea2.datetime_scan DESC LIMIT 1), ea.datetime_scan) END AS duration, CASE WHEN employees.employee_status_id = 1 THEN IFNULL(ea.minute, 0) ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, (SELECT ea2.datetime_scan FROM employee_attendances ea2 WHERE ea2.employee_id = ea.employee_id AND ea2.type = 1 AND ea2.datetime_scan < ea.datetime_scan ORDER BY ea2.datetime_scan DESC LIMIT 1), ea.datetime_scan) END AS minute, ea.type AS attendanceType, ea.status AS attendanceStatus, 'ATTENDANCE_ON_TIME' AS recordType, employees.employee_status_id AS employeeStatusId, IFNULL((SELECT total_day_per_month FROM employee_table_shifts WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{filter.employeeId} AND work_shift_id = ea.work_shift_id LIMIT 1), 0) AS shiftDay FROM employee_attendances ea INNER JOIN employees ON employees.id = ea.employee_id WHERE ea.is_active = 1 AND ea.employee_id = #{filter.employeeId} AND ea.status = 1 AND ea.type = 2 AND MONTH(ea.datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{filter.date}) AND YEAR(ea.datetime_scan) = YEAR(#{filter.date})
SELECT id AS id, name AS name FROM other_bonus WHERE is_active = 1

SELECT branches.id AS branchId, branches.name AS branchName, IFNULL(payroll_other_bonus.amount, 0) AS amount FROM payroll_other_bonus LEFT JOIN branches ON payroll_other_bonus.branch_id = branches.id WHERE payroll_other_bonus.is_active = 1 AND payroll_other_bonus.other_bonus_id = #{bonusId} AND payroll_other_bonus.employee_id = #{filter.employeeId}
SELECT name_en FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{employeesId}
SELECT chat_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{employeesId}
SELECT chat_id FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{employeesId}
SELECT username FROM users WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM payrolls WHERE employee_id = #{employeesId} AND pay_date = #{payDate} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payroll_other_bonus ( payroll_id, employee_id, branch_id, other_bonus_id, amount, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{insertOtherPay.payrollId}, #{insertOtherPay.employeeId}, #{insertOtherPay.branchId}, #{insertOtherPay.bonusId}, #{insertOtherPay.amount}, NOW(), #{insertOtherPay.createdBy}, 1 );

INSERT INTO payroll_details ( payroll_id, payroll_item_id, amount, status, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{payrollDetail.payrollId}, #{payrollDetail.payrollItemId}, #{payrollDetail.amount}, #{payrollDetail.payrollStatus}, NOW(), #{payrollDetail.createdBy}, #{payrollDetail.isActive} );
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM payrolls WHERE employee_id = #{employeesId} AND pay_date = #{payDate} AND is_active = 1
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(increase_salary),0) FROM employee_increase_salaries WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeesId} AND date = #{payDate}
SELECT current_salary FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{employeesId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payroll_locks ( department_id, pay_date, is_lock, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{payrollLock.departmentId}, #{payrollLock.payDate}, #{payrollLock.isLocked}, NOW(), #{payrollLock.createdBy}, 1 );
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) FROM payroll_locks WHERE department_id = #{departmentId} AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}) AND is_active = 1
SELECT current_salary FROM employees WHERE is_active = 1 AND id = #{employeesId}

SELECT *, old_salary AS oldSalary, increase_salary AS increaseSalary FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 2 AND MONTH(pay_date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(pay_date) = YEAR(#{payDate}) AND increase_salary != 0 AND employee_id = #{employeesId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 01
SELECT employee_id AS employeesId FROM payrolls WHERE is_active = 1 AND pay_date = #{filter.payDate} GROUP BY employee_id HAVING COUNT(employee_id) > 1
SELECT date FROM employee_apply_status WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeesId} AND employee_status_id IN(1,2,3) ORDER by id DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(id) FROM employee_apply_status_histories WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND is_active = 1 AND employee_status_id = 2 AND ((#{payDate} BETWEEN date AND date_to) OR (MONTH(employee_apply_status_histories.date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(employee_apply_status_histories.date) = YEAR(#{payDate})) OR (MONTH(employee_apply_status_histories.date_to) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(employee_apply_status_histories.date_to) = YEAR(#{payDate})));

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%d-%b-%y') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(date_to, '%d-%b-%y') AS dateTo FROM employee_apply_status_histories WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND is_active = 1 AND employee_status_id = 2 AND ((#{payDate} BETWEEN date AND date_to) OR (MONTH(employee_apply_status_histories.date) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(employee_apply_status_histories.date) = YEAR(#{payDate})) OR (MONTH(employee_apply_status_histories.date_to) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(employee_apply_status_histories.date_to) = YEAR(#{payDate}))) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(`minute`, 0)), 0) FROM employee_attendances WHERE is_active = 1 AND status IN (2,3) AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND MONTH(datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(datetime_scan) = YEAR(#{payDate})

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_working_minute), 0) FROM employee_attendances WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND type = 2 AND MONTH(datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(datetime_scan) = YEAR(#{payDate})

SELECT IFNULL((CASE WHEN TIME_TO_SEC(duration) = 0 THEN 1440 ELSE TIME_TO_SEC(duration) / 60 END), 0) FROM work_shifts WHERE is_active = 1 AND id IN( SELECT employee_table_shifts.work_shift_id FROM employee_table_shifts WHERE employee_table_shifts.employee_id = #{employeeId} AND employee_table_shifts.is_active = 1 ) LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(total_day_per_month) FROM employee_table_shifts WHERE is_active = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeeId};
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM employee_attendances WHERE is_active = 1 AND type = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND MONTH(datetime_scan) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(datetime_scan) = YEAR(#{payDate})

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(number_of_day), 0) FROM leave_requests WHERE is_active = 1 AND status = 1 AND employee_id = #{employeeId} AND MONTH(date_from) = MONTH(#{payDate}) AND YEAR(date_from) = YEAR(#{payDate}) AND leave_type_id != 7
